Name: Shane is now working in Pierre's Shop for 1.6
Author: witchtopia
Description:
[size=5]🍕 [b]SHANE GOT A NEW JOB![/b] 🌱[/size]

Joja is gone. The Community Center is thriving. And Shane is officially unemployed.

...for about five minutes.

After the Community Center is completed and JojaMart shuts down, Shane can start working a brand-new 9–5 at Pierre's General Store! 🎉
[center]🌻━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━🌻[/center]

[size=4]✨ [b]MOD FEATURES[/b] ✨[/size]

🌱 [b]A brand-new hiring cutscene![/b]
Watch Pierre offer Shane a job after Joja closes its doors.

📦 [b]Three different work positions![/b]
Shane rotates between stocking shelves, working the checkout counter, and taking a scheduled break.

🕘 [b]A proper work schedule![/b]
Shane works roughly [b]9 AM to 5 PM, Monday through Friday[/b], with occasional days off for festivals and Ginger Island trips if the island has been unlocked.

👕 [b]A new Pierre's uniform![/b]
It's just his Joja uniform recolored for Pierre's, to be entirely honest.

💬 [b]New dialogue![/b]
Includes special dialogue for: Shane, Pierre, Caroline, Abigail, Marnie, and Jas.

🧒 [b]Stardew Kids Expansion integration![/b]
If [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7940][b]Stardew Kids Expansion[/b][/url] is installed, Adrian gets his own dialogue acknowledging Shane's new job!

[b]⚖️ Law and Order SV integration!
[/b]If [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23979][b]Law and Order SV[/b][/url]  is installed, Shane steps up at Pierre's while Pierre is... uh... [b]otherwise legally occupied.[/b] 🚓

[b]💰 Romantic Revenue integration![/b]
If [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27043?tab=description][b]Romantic Revenue[/b][/url] is installed, Shane brings home an actual salary from his Seed Shop job when married.

[b]🌧️Always Raining in the Valley integration!
[/b]If [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9999][b]Always Raining in the Valley[/b][/url] is installed, Shane gets dialogue acknowledging Sterling and vice versa.

[center]🌻━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━🌻[/center]

[size=4]🚪 [b]HOW TO START[/b] 🚪[/size]

Once you've completed the Community Center, simply walk into Pierre's General Store. A new cutscene will trigger, Pierre will make Shane an offer, and from then on Shane will begin working at the shop! 🌱✨

🎮 [b]MULTIPLAYER NOTE[/b]
The mod is multiplayer compatible! For the smoothest experience, I recommend having the [b]host trigger the hiring cutscene first[/b].

[center]🌻━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━🌻[/center]

[size=4]💌 [b]A LITTLE CREDIT WHERE CREDIT'S DUE[/b] 💌[/size]

This project originally began as a simple 1.6 patch for BURKAMESE's broken mod, which you can find [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6426][b]right here![/b][/url] Mine has wandered pretty far from the original at this point, but its roots are still there, so credit where credit is due. 🌱
